content.content: When invoked as `deccy new --evaluates <id>...` with one or more ids, the deccy CLI shall record every given id and no other id in the new node's `evaluates` — an id named twice counted once, an id also given to `--on` recorded in both relations, and no id given to this flag reaching `depends_on` on that account — and shall give a node born without the flag no `evaluates` key.
content.rationale: The evaluates linkage is what makes a birth a check as well as a placement, so it is one commitment over any count: reading the flag's ids alone makes an id named twice or in any order land once, keeps placement ids, the summary and the skeleton's fixed fields from supplying an evaluates edge, and leaves the shared case adding an evaluates edge without costing the depends_on one. Stating the unnamed case here keeps absence a property of the relation rather than an empty array the skeleton would have to invent, and leaves the kind split, the guard over unknown ids, resolution and the born node's own content to the nodes that own them.
